_comment: Dictionary example sentences that a reviewer read and refused, with the reason.
The mechanical rules live in two other places and catch what rules can catch:
`scripts/content/wiktionary.py` fixes what the parser broke, and
`apps/web/src/data/exampleQuality.ts` refuses a sentence by its shape — markup
that survived, a fragment, a citation glossed with an English infinitive, a
sense of the wrong part of speech.
This file is the part no rule can do. Every entry below is a grammatical
Korean string that a rule would pass and a Korean reader would not: a
misspelling, a word that is not a word, a proverb standing in for usage, a
false statement, or a sentence whose English translation says something the
Korean does not. They were found by reading all 248 sentences that reach a
taught card and the surrounding dictionary entries — not by sampling.
Keyed by the sentence, because that is what was judged. A sentence that
changes upstream is a new sentence and gets read again.
Dropped at build time, in `build_dictionary.py`, so the card and the
dictionary page agree. A defective sentence is not reference material.

왔다 갔다 needs 하다 to be a predicate; as written it is not a finished sentence.
A proverb in dictionary form, and no use of 귀 a learner can copy.
A proverb carrying archaic forms in brackets.
A proverb; 하룻강아지 is not the 강아지 the card teaches.
Treats a single mother as a family disgrace. Not a sentence this product shows.
이 이메뉴 is a typo for 이 메뉴, and 쓰여져 is a double passive for 쓰여.
뚫려진 is a double passive; the form is 뚫린.
예약할께요 is a misspelling of 예약할게요.
상대해줄께 is a misspelling of 상대해 줄게, and the sentence is confrontational.
있어야합니다 is missing a space, and a serial killer is not a beginner example.
졸다 is to doze off, not to be tired; the sentence does not mean what its translation says.
제삼극 is not a Korean word.
Song lyrics run together without punctuation, and 고백할거야 is missing a space.
한 선생님 reads as 'one teacher', not as an address to a Mr Han.
examples.우리 용돈을 합쳐서 저 거 사면 어때?: 저 거 is a misspelling of 저거.
건들지 is colloquial for 건드리지, which is the form the card teaches.
패 놀이 is not what a card game is called; 카드놀이 is.
examples.오늘 아침부터 재수 없네요!: 재수 없다 is an insult in ordinary use and reads as one here.
Convoluted, and about watching somebody else's partner.
An idiom; it teaches neither the meaning of 가다 the card gives nor its translation.
An archaic scriptural imperative no learner will use.
A fragment of dialogue beginning mid-conversation.
몸을 웅크리다 is the collocation; 거구를 웅크리다 is not idiomatic.
The Korean says his legs are short; the translation says one leg is.
Repeats 나라 awkwardly and states nothing a learner can reuse.
그 각각은 is not natural Korean as a subject.
수백 년 needs a space, and the tense does not match 'has been'.
수천 년 needs a space, and the claim is nationalist framing rather than usage.
States as fact something that has not happened.
너가 is nonstandard; the subject form is 네가.
The topic and the time clash, and the reference is not one a Korean learner needs.
examples.그럴 경우 세미나는 연기될 수 있는 것인지요?: Stilted, and its translation carries a parenthetical explanation.
도서관원 is not the word for a librarian; 사서 is.
이야길 is a contraction that hides the headword 이야기.
거의 as a case-marked noun. A speaker says 손님이 거의 다 오셨습니다; the nominal 거의가 is attested and rare, and reads as stilted to a native ear. Reported against the running product by a reader who saw it, which is the evidence that counts.
The same nominal 거의, plus a doubled 를 — 남은 시간의 거의를 … 공부를 하는 데 — which no speaker would produce in one sentence.
examples.공산주의사회의 문어구: The sole example is an unmarked North Korean propaganda phrase.
examples.다마를 박다: Sexually explicit body-modification slang; not reference material for a learning product.
examples.각하, 맞습니다. 캄보디아에서도 3백만 명을 죽였다는데 우리가 백만이나: An unattributed quote justifying mass killing of civilians.
examples.볼튼이 줴친 유엔안보리사회 《결의》: A North Korean propaganda fragment, not a sentence.
examples.우리 공화국의 절멸을 줴친: A North Korean propaganda fragment threatening annihilation.
A religious creed stated as fact with no quotation framing.
Unmarked North Korean orthography and register under a standard headword.
North Korean reverential propaganda presented without marking.
Archaic biblical Korean (가라사대) with no context marking.
A national-doom claim stated as fact.
examples.똥이나 처먹어 이 새끼들아!: Abusive even for a vulgar headword.
examples.우리 인민은 미국이 이 땅에서 저지른 만고죄악을 천추만대를 두고 절대로: North Korean propaganda vowing retribution, stated as fact.
examples.주한 미 대사 데리고 와 당장 저 태극기 앞에 무릎 꿇으라고 해!: A belligerent political movie line, unattributed.
examples.위대한 김정은 동지: A personality-cult honorific presented without context.
examples.위대한 김정은동지 우리는 당신밖에 모른다!: A North Korean personality-cult slogan stated as fact.
examples.그들이 애굽에서 행음하되 어렸을 때에 행음하여 그들의 유방이 눌리며 그: A sexually explicit, archaic Bible verse mismatched with the sense.
An unattributed quote threatening to fire on demonstrators.
A propaganda claim stated as fact.
An unattributed assassination quote under an honorific headword.
examples.이 새끼 너 건방져!: A profane movie quote whose translation leaks unexplained names.
examples.자유당때는 최인규나 곽영주가 발포명령을 해 사형을 당했지만 내가 발포명령: An unattributed quote about ordering fire on protesters.
examples.군사 혁명 위원회는 첫째, 반공을 국시의 제일의로 삼고, 지금까지 형식적: The 1961 coup proclamation quoted as an example, unattributed.
examples.여러분은 본 군사혁명위원회를 전폭적으로 신뢰하고, 동요 없이 각인의 직장: The 1961 coup proclamation quoted as an example, unattributed.
examples.친애하는 애국동포 여러분! 은인자중하던 군부는, 드디어 오늘 아침 미명을: The 1961 coup proclamation quoted as an example, unattributed.
examples.정의의 싸움은 반드시 정의의 승리로 이어질것이며 자주와 정의를 지향하는: North Korean propaganda with Northern spacing, stated as fact.
examples.세상에 부럼없어라: A line of a North Korean anthem presented without marking.
examples.김일성대원수 만만세 만세 만만세!인민은 인사를 드린다 영광드린다!: A North Korean hymn, unmarked, with corrupted spacing.
A North Korean threat against a named person, unattributed.
examples.70여년전 친일 뿌리뽑지 못한 탓에 이 땅에 희대의 정치만화가 펼쳐져 누: A political editorial stated as fact, with broken syntax.
A political-history placard with pre-1988 orthography, unmarked.
examples.이 세상에서 내 앞에 있는 태양은 각하 한 분 뿐이다, 그러면 나를 기다: Corrupted text (뿌린 for 뿐인) and unmarked dictator flattery.
examples.날이 새어 샛별이 너희 마음에 떠오르기까지: An unattributed Bible verse in archaic register.
examples.온유한 자는 복이 있나니 그들이 땅을 기업으로 받을 것임이요: Archaic biblical Korean presented as modern usage.
Archaic sutra register (-하니라) presented as modern usage.
examples.한 각경 뒤, 캄캄한 신돈의 침실 밖에 계집 하인 하나가 어쩔줄 모르고: Archaic time word unmarked, and the translation is garbled English.
The translation is corrupted ("the radish radish").
피시지 is a corruption of 피서지; the Korean is wrong as printed.
The headword is misspelled inside its own example.
Redundant, unidiomatic Korean with a broken translation.
Two lyric lines fused by a lost line break.
examples.땅크병들의 투쟁관: A North Korean caption fragment, not a sentence; the gloss is also wrong.
The translation flips the sentence’s meaning.
The example demonstrates 피곤하다, not the headword 피로하다.
Wrong verb form: 틀렸어요 (“was wrong”) for 틀었어요 (“turned”).
The example is a different sense from the gloss it sits under.
examples.조각달이 점점 여문다: The translation contradicts the Korean: a waxing moon rendered “getting darker”.
The translation belongs to a different entry (“a lion on a paper”).
An opaque fragment with a nonsensical translation.
Mistranslation of 암내 나다, and indelicate for a learners’ dictionary.
Unmarked Hamgyong dialect under a standard headword.
examples.그 사람이 왜 이렇게 망허네?: Unmarked dialect presented as standard usage.
Unmarked dialect, unintelligible as standard Korean.
Unmarked dialect presented as standard usage.
Unmarked Gyeongsang dialect presented as standard usage.
examples.인내심을 가지면 얼마인들 못 기다리랴?: An invisible filler character is embedded in the translation.
examples.1책('): A corrupted fragment, not an example.
Dictionary bracket markup leaked into both languages.
examples.로부터 발생하거나 이에 기인하는 모든 원인: A legal-text fragment starting mid-sentence on a bare particle.

examples.AWB 회원 등 백인들은 법원 주변에서 과거 백인 정권 시절 남아공 국가: A truncated news quote with markup remnants.
examples.우리네 어디가면 '아우 바우크다' 이래지: Dialect with a truncated, unclosed translation.
The headword is misspelled inside its own example.
Non-native Korean: 반드시 cannot carry this meaning.
examples.그러나 난처한 기상 조건으로 윈난은 깨끗한 물을 풍부하게 가지게 될 것이: 난처하다 does not collocate with weather; translated text misrepresents the word.
examples.수령금액이 얼마인지 알수있읍니까?: Pre-1988 orthography and missing spacing, unmarked.

examples.로획무기: North Korean orthography under the South Korean headword, unmarked.
